correction.text: the northern half of Korea: 'The SCA governed the northern half of Korea'; Cliopatria's 1948 outline of the DPRK is the best match

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no row for 1945-1947; its DPRK shape starts 1948). The page gives no area and never mentions the 38th parallel, only 'the northern half of Korea'; the 1948 DPRK outline stands in.

region.text: the northern half of Korea: 'The SCA governed the northern half of Korea'; Cliopatria's 1948 outline of the DPRK is the best match

ledger.note: 24 August 1945: the Soviet Civil Administration is formed in the north. Infobox 'Formation: 24 August 1945'; 'The SCA governed the northern half of Korea from 24 August 1945'. The page does not give the 38th parallel or an October 1945 date.

February 1946: the Soviet administration hands day-to-day government to the Provisional People's Committee for North Korea. The Soviets 'co-opted the PRK committees on 8 February 1946'; the infobox gives 'Provisional People's Committee (1946-1947)', then 'People's Committee (1947-1948)', chaired by Kim Il Sung. The zone and its tint do not change.

region.text: the northern half of Korea: 'The SCA governed the northern half of Korea'; Cliopatria's 1948 outline of the DPRK is the best match

ledger.note: 9 September 1948: the DPRK replaces the Soviet administration. The page's own dates conflict (10 July proclamation against 9 September extinction); the infobox's 9 September matches the DPRK dossier's founding (jk-02-d).

certainty.note: The line of the Soviet zone is the 38th parallel (not on the page).

sources.title: Soviet Civil Administration
sources.note: 24 August 1945-9 September 1948; Chistyakov chose Pyongyang; Provisional People's Committee 8 February 1946; Shtykov, Romanenko, Lebedev; Soviet withdrawal December 1948.

notes: Colony (occupation zone) filling the 1945-48 gap in the north. Page disagreements: the DPRK is 'proclaimed on 10 July 1948' in the text against 'July-September 1948' and extinction 9 September in the infobox. The DPRK dossier (jk-02-d) starts 1948-09 with the USSR as predecessor. The USSR dossier (eu-17) should carry the occupation_start (counterpart empire-of-japan) at 1945-08. Not on the page: the 38th parallel, area and population, an October 1945 Civil Administration, the 25 September 1948 withdrawal date (the text says December).
